newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish FinMin sees room for lower interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Swedish FinMin sees room for lower interest rates.

text.p: Sweden's Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said on Tuesday he saw scope for further falls in Swedish debt yields as the financial markets assimilated the economic recovery now in progress.
Speaking at a Nordic Finance Forum, Asbrink said financial markets have not fully understood the economic recovery that has taken place in Sweden over the past year.
"We have not yet seen interest rates bottom out," he said.
"If you compare Sweden with the other European countries, there is no reason for Sweden to have higher interest rates. Why has Sweden higher rates than Finland, for example?" he said.
